catalog_images_primary_ready.name: catalog_images_primary_ready
catalog_images_primary_ready.value: not "catalog_images"."is_primary" or ("catalog_images"."state" = 'ready' and "catalog_images"."product_id" is not null)

store_design_publication.name: store_design_publication
store_design_publication.value:
num_nonnulls("store_designs"."published", "store_designs"."published_revision", "store_designs"."published_at") in (0, 3)
    and ("store_designs"."published" is null or (jsonb_typeof("store_designs"."published") = 'object' and "store_designs"."published_revision" between 1 and "store_designs"."revision"))

order_items_bounds.name: order_items_bounds
order_items_bounds.value: "order_intent_items"."position" between 1 and 12 and "order_intent_items"."quantity" between 1 and 20 and "order_intent_items"."unit_minor" >= 0 and jsonb_typeof("order_intent_items"."options") = 'array'

billing_config_bounds.name: billing_config_bounds
billing_config_bounds.value: "billing_config"."id" = 1 AND "billing_config"."trial_days" between 1 and 30 AND "billing_config"."grace_days" between 0 and 30 AND "billing_config"."trial_products" between 1 and 30

billing_method_text.name: billing_method_text
billing_method_text.value: length(btrim("billing_methods"."label")) between 1 and 100 and length(btrim("billing_methods"."instructions")) between 1 and 1600

billing_plan_valid.name: billing_plan_valid
billing_plan_valid.value: "billing_plans"."code" in ('starter','pro') AND "billing_plans"."version" > 0 AND "billing_plans"."max_products" between 1 and 10000 AND "billing_plans"."storage_mib" between 6 and 1000000 AND "billing_plans"."analytics" in ('basic','enhanced')

billing_review_evidence.name: billing_review_evidence
billing_review_evidence.value: case when "billing_reviews"."approved" then "billing_reviews"."reconciliation_ref" is not null and "billing_reviews"."reason" is null else "billing_reviews"."reason" is not null and "billing_reviews"."reconciliation_ref" is null end
